meta.title: Demonology Job Sites (Maps)

sources.label: Demonology Wiki (Fandom) - Job Sites (canonical roster, sizes, unlock levels)
Demonology Wiki (Fandom) - per-map pages (Fenway Drive, Juniper Road, Lincoln Street, Bodega, Lilim Lane, Cafe, Bridgewood Drive, Oakbridge Estates, Prison, School, Asylum)

sourceNotes: Roster locked to the live canonical Demonology Fandom Job Sites page: 4 Small, 4 Medium, 3 Large = 11 maps total. The page's intro sentence explicitly states '4 Small Job Sites, 4 Medium Job Sites, and 3 Large Job Sites', and the per-map sections enumerate exactly those 11.

The brief's open 10-vs-11 question resolves to 11. The 11th map is Oakbridge Estates, a current 4th Medium job site (released V1.9.0, unlocked at Level 25). It is real and in the live roster, not invented.
The stale/fictional 'Office' map (from demonology.wiki) is correctly absent from the live Fandom roster and is NOT included.

Disputed unlock levels resolved against the live per-map infoboxes: Bodega = Level 6, Lilim Lane = Level 4, Prison = Level 9. All three are taken from the 'Unlocked at' infobox row on the Job Sites page.
Fenway Drive, Juniper Road, and Lincoln Street are starter maps shown as 'Level 0 (Starter)' on the wiki; represented here as unlockLevel 0 with a 'Default' display intent.

Floor counts: Fandom does not publish an explicit numeric floor field. Floors here are derived from the room/area listings on each map (e.g. F1/F2 hallway references, Basement rooms, multi-story room sets). Floors are conservative and flagged as derived; treat as best-effort, not a published stat. Where a map's storey count is not clearly derivable, floors is null.
Notes/cardSummary are written in original wording from the source facts (theme, release order, size relevance). No active-code-style or dated/freshness language is used; copy is evergreen.

Images are deferred to the image gate. Every image field is null at this stage. The Fandom Job Sites page exposes a map-select icon per site; the image gate will source/capture one clean screenshot per map and wire local paths (best-effort; a missing image for one or two maps is not a blocker).
meta.imageStatus: deferred to image gate; null at this stage

items.name: Fenway Drive
items.cardSummary: A small suburban listing flagged by a worried real estate agent, and one of the three starter homes available from the very beginning.
items.notes: One of the original launch job sites, unlocked from the start with no level requirement. A compact single-family home that suits quick, low-risk investigations and early money runs.
items.verificationNote: Size (Small) and 'Unlocked at Level 0 (Starter)' confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Floors derived from single-home room set; treated as 1.

items.name: Juniper Road
items.cardSummary: A small reported-haunting house and one of the tightest maps in the game, making it a popular pick for fast, efficient runs.
items.notes: A launch job site available from the start. Its small, compact layout means short walking distances between rooms, which is why many players favor it for quick investigations.
items.verificationNote: Size (Small) and 'Unlocked at Level 0 (Starter)' confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Floors derived from single-home room set; treated as 1.

items.name: Lincoln Street
items.cardSummary: A small family home with a basement, called in by residents reporting paranormal activity, available from the start of the game.
items.notes: An original launch job site unlocked from the start. Unlike the other starter homes it includes a basement level, giving it more spawn areas to search despite its small footprint.
items.verificationNote: Size (Small) and 'Unlocked at Level 0 (Starter)' confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Basement rooms appear in the spawn lists, so floors derived as 2 (ground + basement).

items.name: Bodega
items.cardSummary: An NYC corner-store bodega reported for ghostly activity, the only small job site themed as a shop rather than a home.
items.notes: A later small job site set in a New York-style corner store with a store floor plus back and upper rooms. It is the only non-residential small map and unlocks once the player reaches the required level.
items.verificationNote: DISPUTE RESOLVED: 'Unlocked at Level 6' confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox (brief had 6 vs 7). Size Small and V1.4.0 release confirmed. Floors derived as 2 from the store/back-room and upstairs Living Room/Bedroom layout; flagged as derived.

items.name: Lilim Lane
items.cardSummary: A traditional two-story Filipino home reported as haunted by its architect, the first medium-sized job site to unlock.
items.notes: The earliest medium job site, themed as a traditional Filipino house spread over two floors with foyer, bedrooms, and an office. It is the natural step up once players outgrow the starter homes.
items.verificationNote: DISPUTE RESOLVED: 'Unlocked at Level 4' confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox (brief had 4 vs 5). Size Medium and V1.2.0 release confirmed. Floors derived as 2 from F1/F2 hallway room references.

items.name: Cafe
items.cardSummary: HVNLY Coffee, a medium two-floor cafe where customers were harmed by flying furniture, mixing public dining areas with back-of-house rooms.
items.notes: A medium job site set in a coffee shop with a ground-floor coffee bar and an upper dining area plus staff rooms, an alley, and an office. Its mix of open and tight rooms makes for a varied search.
items.verificationNote: Size Medium, 'Unlocked at Level 8', and V1.3.0 release confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Floors derived as 2 from the 'F2 Dining Area' reference.

items.name: Bridgewood Drive
items.cardSummary: A high-end forest mansion reported by a wealthy client, a multi-story medium job site that is one of the larger homes in the medium tier.
items.notes: A medium job site themed as a forest mansion, with a garage, den, multiple bedrooms, and bathrooms across more than one floor. It carries one of the higher unlock requirements in the medium tier.
items.verificationNote: Size Medium, 'Unlocked at Level 16', and V1.5.0 release confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Floors derived as 3 from the F2 hallway plus garage and multi-level room set; flagged as derived (brief noted three-story).

items.name: Oakbridge Estates
items.cardSummary: A multi-unit estate where a haunting was reported with an unknown origin, the newest and highest-unlock medium job site.
items.notes: A recent medium job site built as a cluster of estate units (rooms grouped under numbers like 561, 562, and 563), giving it a sprawling, repeated-layout feel. It has the highest unlock level of any medium map.
items.verificationNote: This is the 11th map that resolves the brief's 10-vs-11 question. Size Medium, 'Unlocked at Level 25', and V1.9.0 release confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Storey count is not clearly derivable from the unit-numbered room set, so floors is null.

items.name: Prison
items.cardSummary: A shut-down state prison where a ghost caused several injuries, the first large job site players unlock.
items.notes: An original launch job site and the entry point into the large tier, with cells, a courtyard, an infirmary, kitchen, and library spread across multiple areas. Its long corridors make for a slower, more demanding search.
items.verificationNote: DISPUTE RESOLVED: 'Unlocked at Level 9' confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox (brief had 8 vs 9). Size Large and V1.0.0 release confirmed. Floors derived as 2 from the multi-level room set; flagged as derived.

items.name: School
items.cardSummary: A school where students were hurt by objects thrown by nothing, a large multi-floor job site full of classrooms and offices.
items.notes: A large job site with classrooms, a cafeteria, library, common rooms, and offices across two floors. The many similar rooms and long hallways make it one of the more time-consuming maps to clear.
items.verificationNote: Size Large, 'Unlocked at Level 13', and V1.1.0 release confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Floors derived as 2 from 'F2 Restroom' and stairwell references.

items.name: Asylum
items.cardSummary: A 20th-century lunatic asylum long rumored to be haunted, the largest job site in the game with the highest unlock level.
items.notes: The biggest job site in Demonology, themed as an old asylum with therapy rooms, an X-ray lab, sleeping halls, and a basement across multiple floors. Its size and high unlock level make it a late-game challenge.
items.verificationNote: Size Large, 'Unlocked at Level 20', and V1.7.0 release confirmed from the live Job Sites infobox. Floors derived as 3 from F1/F2 hallway plus Basement Hallway references; flagged as derived (brief noted three-story).
